title: A workout that keeps failing to save leaves no note of why, and MettleUp never hears of it
what: When the live workout's automatic save fails, the member sees the 'Couldn't save' line and the app tries again every few seconds. But the reason is not written anywhere, not even to the phone's own log, and nothing is sent to MettleUp. Only a full phone is recognised by its words; any other cause (a damaged file, a bug) shows 'We'll keep trying' for ever with no trace. If a new version broke saving on many phones, MettleUp would learn of it only when members lose workouts and write in.
expected: Every failed save writes its reason to the phone log, and a save that keeps failing is counted and sent to MettleUp (no personal data), so a broken save is seen before members complain.
fix_line: Log the reason of each failed save and report a save that fails several times in a row

title: The Charts page says 'Couldn't load' with Try again but keeps no note of why
what: When the Charts page, the lift chart, the muscle sheet or the top records cannot be read, the member sees 'Couldn't load' and a Try again button, but the reason is thrown away. Several smaller reads on the page quietly fall back to empty with no trace. The two sign-in notices on the Workout tab also read the workout count with nothing to catch a failure, so a failed read leaves no note at all.
expected: Every 'Couldn't load' and every quiet fallback writes its reason to the phone log, like the body map already does.
fix_line: Add a log line with the reason in each failed read

title: The quiet install of a downloaded update probably never happens while the app is in the background
what: After Google Play downloads an update, the app plans to install it quietly one minute after the member leaves the app. That plan is an in-app timer started as the app goes to the background. On Android, the app's timers normally pause while it is in the background, and coming back cancels the timer, so the quiet install most likely never runs and the update waits for the member to tap Restart. Not proven on a phone.
expected: A downloaded update installs on its own while the app is closed, or the member is told it waits for a tap; a phone test shows which.
fix_line: Prove it on a phone; if it never fires, move the quiet install into the phone's own background work

title: MettleUp cannot see whether the Workout tab notices work
what: The member app sends no usage counts at all. So nobody can tell how many members see 'Your workouts are only on this phone' and then sign in, how many tap 'Install on watch', 'Update now' or 'Later', or read What's new. Sign-ups can be counted from accounts on the server, but not which notice brought them, and members who never sign in are invisible, so choices about these notices are made blind.
expected: A few counts without personal data (shown, tapped, closed) for each notice, so you can see which ones bring sign-ups and watch installs.
fix_line: Count shown and tapped for each Workout tab notice, with no personal data
